name: SPEED multi-scale sampling
plain: Starts sampling at a low-resolution DCT crop of the latent and at chosen sigmas expands to higher resolution with a spectral method, realigning sigma. Transitions are found by a delta rule from a fitted power spectrum, or given manually. Reduces latent size during early steps.
math: Segments: any base sample_* on sigmas[start:end+1]. At transition: (x,σ̃)=_expand_and_align(x,s_i,s_next,σ); sigmas[step]=σ̃. Delta-optimal picks transitions from spectrum A/f^β, defaults A=203.615097, β=1.915461, δ=0.01.

providers.author: sorryhyun
providers.note: Euler-only op-for-op loop; re-spaces remaining sigmas by σ̃/old, DCT on (B,C,1,H,W) view

label: from code
surprise: Spectrum variant rescales remaining sigmas after each handoff, which ruwwww does not do beyond one entry.
